module origen_163665(
    input wire y,
    input wire clk,
    output reg [6:0] a_to_g,
    output wire [3:0] an,
    output wire dp
);

    reg [19:0] clkdiv;
    reg [3:0] digit;
    reg [3:0] aen;
    reg [1:0] s;
    reg [15:0] x;

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        clkdiv <= clkdiv + 1;
        s <= clkdiv[19:18];
    end

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        case (s)
            2'b00: digit <= x[3:0];
            2'b01: digit <= x[7:4];
            2'b10: digit <= x[11:8];
            2'b11: digit <= x[15:12];
        endcase
    end

    always @(*) begin
        case (digit)
            4'b0000: a_to_g = 7'b1000000;
            4'b0001: a_to_g = 7'b1111001;
            4'b0010: a_to_g = 7'b0100100;
            4'b0011: a_to_g = 7'b0110000;
            4'b0100: a_to_g = 7'b0011001;
            4'b0101: a_to_g = 7'b0010010;
            4'b0110: a_to_g = 7'b0000010;
            4'b0111: a_to_g = 7'b1111000;
            4'b1000: a_to_g = 7'b0000000;
            4'b1001: a_to_g = 7'b0010000;
            default: a_to_g = 7'b1000000;
        endcase
    end

    always @(*) begin
        case (s)
            2'b00: aen = 4'b1110;
            2'b01: aen = 4'b1101;
            2'b10: aen = 4'b1011;
            2'b11: aen = 4'b0111;
        endcase
    end

    assign an = aen;
    assign dp = 1'b1;

endmodule
